name: Domia
source: Domia held the esteemed position of captain of Fahda's guard. During Karder's visit to the oasis of Ziruan, she shared the story of how she came to earn this role. Domia was brought to the oasis as a slave and purchased by Lady Fahda out of compassion. Close in age to Alam, Fahda's daughter, Domia spent much of her time studying alongside her, but it soon became evident that Domia excelled in physical skills such as dancing and gymnastics. In her spare time, she cane and began practicing fencing on her own, imagining battles as she played.
